page.overview:
Who is Archie?

Archie, better known as Fear Bear is a recurring scenario character in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles & Other Strangeness by Palladium Books. Fear Bear is a member of the Terror Bears, a team of four teenage mutant bears.

By all outward appearances, Fear Bear seems to be good-natured. However, he harbors an intense hatred and though quiet, he is quite vengeful.

Of the four members of the Terror Bears it is Fear Bear who has the most bitter hatred of humanity. He uses his See Aura ability to learn what his victims are the most frightened of, and then he will Mind Trap them into a number of fantasies which forces them to face their worst fears and phobias.

Fear Bear has a fondness for Doom Bear and whenever it is possible, will follow him.
